question: File the motion to compel further responses now, or send one more meet-and-confer letter first?
context: The motion is due Tue Oct 27 2026 (45 days from the Sept 9 responses + 2 court days e-service). A motion needs a meet-and-confer declaration either way.

options.label: Send the letter, ask for supplemental responses by Oct 16, file the motion by Oct 27 if they do not arrive
options.cost: one letter; the motion work waits until Oct 16
options.worst_case: late supplemental responses arrive Oct 26 and leave one day to review them

options.label: File the motion now
options.cost: motion, separate statement and declaration this week; filing fee
options.worst_case: the court finds the meet-and-confer effort thin and denies sanctions
